repo_meta_data.description: An MCP server for public & prediction markets research. Ask natural-language questions and get structured, source-backed answers across SEC filings, earnings transcripts, company financials, stock & crypto market data, and prediction markets news & research. Built for investors, analysts, and researchers who need fast, cited intelligence.
